digest.component_or_area: completion verifier epic-close bug screen and close gate
propositions: The epic-close bug screen converts systematic LLM provider errors (including per-candidate Bedrock ValidationException failures) into C (unrelated) verdicts via broad exception degradation, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor evaluation with no aggregate signal in verdict or exit code

max_output_cfg in review_kernel/verify.py only raises the token ceiling and never re-clamps when a smaller model is resolved later, causing the 128K Sonnet cap to carry into Haiku 64K calls, triggering Bedrock 400 validation errors deterministically

The completion verifier must fail-closed (nonzero exit, error naming provider failure, ticket stays in_progress) when LLMUnavailableError is raised from the bug screen, consistent with the absent-provider path, with --force-close as the sole escape hatch

epic-close bug screen's per-candidate degrade-open behavior is intentional for non-provider failures but creates a safety blind spot when all 32 candidates fail with the same systematic provider error
